pass_rate.name: Neutral-script pass rate
pass_rate.formula: pass plays / scrimmage plays with wp in [0.20, 0.80] and > 2:00 left in the half (kneels/spikes excluded)

proe.name: Pass rate over expectation
proe.formula: mean nflverse pass_oe (pass − xpass, down/distance/score/time expectation) over scrimmage plays

sec_per_play.name: Neutral-script pace
sec_per_play.formula: drive time of possession / drive play count, drives starting in neutral script

goal_line_qb_rush_share.name: Goal-line QB rush share
goal_line_qb_rush_share.formula: designed QB rushes (rusher threw >= 20 passes that season, not a scramble) / rushes inside the 5

rb_committee_hhi.name: RB carry concentration (Herfindahl)
rb_committee_hhi.formula: sum over rushers of (carries_i / team carries)^2, QB rushes and scrambles excluded

rb1_carry_share.name: RB1 carry share
rb1_carry_share.formula: largest single-rusher carry share, QB rushes and scrambles excluded

fourth_down_go_rate.name: 4th-down aggressiveness
fourth_down_go_rate.formula: go-for-it (pass/run) / 4th & <=3 decisions with wp in [0.10, 0.90], > 2:00 left in the half, regulation

rz_pass_rate.name: Red-zone pass rate
rz_pass_rate.formula: pass plays / scrimmage plays with yardline_100 <= 20

rz_td_rate.name: Red-zone TD rate
rz_td_rate.formula: drives reaching the 20 that end in a touchdown / drives reaching the 20

top_per_game.name: Time of possession per game
top_per_game.formula: sum of drive time of possession / games

model_pick_policy.policy: highest ladder rung with model probability >= 55% (fallback: most probable rung when >= 45%); safe floor shown separately at >= 75%
model_pick_policy.evidence: store/audits/milestone_policy.json — as-of 2025 walk-forward, every probability band calibrated within ~2pp; v1 (65%) headlined the minimum rung on 64% of picks and OVER-claimed for stars (claimed .686 -> observed .641)

target_2025.note: the sim draws targets multinomially AND multiplies shares by lognormal(SHARE_NOISE_SD); the empirical excess beyond the multinomial null is the scale the lognormal should carry

week1_cohort_stability.note: error = Week-1 observed target share minus prior-season mean share, established (>=0.15 prior share, >=6 prior games) receivers, seasons 2021-2025 pooled; rookies excluded (no prior share to err against)

challenger_verdicts._tsn15: TARGET share noise 0.30->0.15, carry unchanged (matches measured empirical excess beyond multinomial sampling, 0.0-0.13 by cohort). Receiving qloss improves ~0.4% (5/6 w1-2 seasons + in-season), center MAE improves, receiving ladder mid-bins improve (+7pp -> +3pp) — but RECEPTIONS rung calibration degrades from ~±2pp to -4/-5pp over-claiming. EXPERIMENTAL — not promoted: gains small, and it trades away the best-calibrated instrument in the system.
challenger_verdicts._tsn10: As _tsn15 at 0.10 — same trade-off, receptions degradation slightly worse. EXPERIMENTAL.
challenger_verdicts._sn20: Both shares reduced to 0.20 — rushing_attempts coverage degrades (.654->.624). REJECTED.
challenger_verdicts._sn15: Both shares reduced to 0.15 — rushing_attempts F10 .138->.169 (low tail far too thin). REJECTED.
challenger_verdicts._sn10: Both shares reduced to 0.10 — worst attempts damage. REJECTED.
challenger_verdicts._csn40: CARRY share noise 0.30->0.40 (committee excess 0.37-0.49 suggested it). Attempts interval coverage improves (.698->.729) but PROPER scores worsen everywhere (attempts qloss +1%, rushing band qloss 9.06->9.52, MAE up). REJECTED — attempts under-coverage is a team-rush-volume/script question, not a share-noise one.

prop_distribution_health.final_decision: DISTRIBUTION CHALLENGER REMAINS EXPERIMENTAL — champion distribution unchanged (TARGET_SHARE_NOISE_SD=CARRY_SHARE_NOISE_SD=0.30, DISTRIBUTION_VERSION=1). The audited pathology is predominantly LOW-BIASED CENTERS (weeks 1-2 especially: F(median)=.33 in the 25-55 band), which no honest width change fixes; widths in meaningful projection bands are approximately calibrated (cov80 tie-aware .78-.84 vs nominal .80). The reduced-target-noise challenger (_tsn15) is retained as evidence but not promoted.
prop_distribution_health.explainer: F(qX) is the tie-aware share of outcomes below the predicted X% quantile — calibrated when it equals X%. cov80 is F(q90)-F(q10), nominal .80. qloss is the pinball average (proper score; lower is better). Raw inclusive coverage is inflated by the zero atom and no longer quoted.
